phases.title: Create src/schemas/userSchema.ts — Zod schema for PATCH /api/users/me body
phases.notes: Created patchMeSchema with two refines: at least one of username/email/newPassword must be provided, and currentPassword is required when newPassword is set. Build passes.

phases.title: Create src/services/userService.ts — updateUser with atomic DB update, bcrypt hashing, uniqueness checks
phases.notes: Created userService.ts with updateUser: verifies currentPassword before password change, checks email/username uniqueness against other users, builds a single atomic SQL UPDATE. Build passes. Tests remain at 8 failures but all are 404s (route not mounted yet — that's phases 3 and 4).

phases.title: Add patchMeHandler to src/controllers/authController.ts and verify meHandler uses only JWT userId
phases.notes: Added patchMeHandler that reads userId from req.jwtPayload, delegates to userService.updateUser, and returns { user }. meHandler already used req.jwtPayload?.userId (not URL params) so no changes needed there — the ownership test passes. All 8 remaining failures are PATCH /api/users/me returning 404 because the route is not yet mounted (phase 4). Build passes.

phases.title: Create src/routes/userRoutes.ts and mount it in src/app.ts
phases.notes: Created userRoutes.ts with PATCH /me protected by requireJwt and validate(patchMeSchema), calling patchMeHandler. Mounted at /api/users in app.ts. All 44 tests pass, build clean.
